Latin word

tollō

tollō, tollere, sustulī, sublātum

verb, third conjugation

do away with, get rid of; lift, raise; pick up

In this lexicon

  • get rid of

    also used · classical

  • lift

    the recommended word · classical

Examples

  • Strāgulum tollō et dēmittō.

    I lift and lower the duvet.composed

    In the entry for lift

  • pellem anguīnam ubi vīderis, tollitō et conditō, nē quaerās cum opus siet

    when you see a snakeskin, pick it up and put it away, so that you needn’t look for it when it’s neededCato Agr. 73

    In the entry for lift

  • ego tamen duo sustulī et ecce in mappā alligāta habeō

    still, I took two, and here they are, tied up in my napkinPetr. 66.1

    In the entry for lift
